526:t_2:38.en:
$$かなめ$$
「(This is resonance between $$ウィスパード$$...)」

526:t_2:39.en:
$$かなめ$$
「(Right now, I'm looking at his past...)」

526:t_2:44.en:
$$レナード$$
「It's just as you saw.」

526:t_2:45.en:
$$レナード$$
「That day... When intruders broke into our home, my mother offered me up to them.」

526:t_2:46.en:
$$レナード$$
「Maybe they were people from some organization posing as robbers to get their hands on me and $$テレサ$$, or maybe she was trying to save at least $$テレサ$$...」

526:t_2:47.en:
$$レナード$$
「That I knew about her infidelity, things like that, don't matter. At that moment, my own mother denied my very existence.」

526:t_2:49.en:
$$レナード$$
「$$テレサ$$ doesn't know about this...」

526:t_2:50.en:
$$レナード$$
「And I didn't show you that to win your sympathy.」

526:t_2:52.en:
$$レナード$$
「Nor do I intend to justify myself with trauma.」

526:t_2:53.en:
$$レナード$$
「I think and act. Of my own will. My mother's curse has nothing to do with it.」

526:t_2:55.en:
$$レナード$$
「Just as you said, I opened my heart... That's all there is to it.」

526:t_2:56.en:
$$かなめ$$
「...I don't understand. Why would someone like you... me...」

526:t_2:61.en:
$$かなめ$$
「$$カリーニン$$... Why are you with $$アマルガム$$...」

526:t_3:4.en:
$$レナード$$
「They're holding out quite stubbornly, I see.」

526:t_3:5.en:
$$かなめ$$
「The $c... $$宗介$$ has made it all the way here!?」

526:t_3:9.en:
$$レナード$$
「What will you do if you see him? Embrace and run off together?」

526:t_3:11.en:
$$レナード$$
「You're torn. You wonder if you, who turned your back on him even once, can go to him now.」

526:t_3:12.en:
$$レナード$$
「Even now, with him having come this far risking his life, you're still torn.」

526:t_3:13.en:
$$かなめ$$
「(I want to see $$宗介$$... I want him to hold me...)」

526:t_3:14.en:
$$かなめ$$
「(These feelings are definitely real... But I don't understand...)」

526:t_3:15.en:
$$かなめ$$
「(Why am I not desperately trying to escape...)」

526:t_3:16.en:
$$レナード$$
「If you're still torn, let's make a bet.」

526:t_3:18.en:
$$レナード$$
「I'll hand you this gun.」

526:t_3:20.en:
$$レナード$$
「I said we'd make a bet, didn't I?」

526:t_3:21.en:
$$レナード$$
「If you truly want to see him, just shoot me dead and go.」

526:t_3:23.en:
$$レナード$$
「I'll wait thirty seconds from now. Decide by then.」

526:t_3:24.en:
$$かなめ$$
「(He isn't wearing that bulletproof coat... Right now he's a helpless, flesh-and-blood human...)」

526:t_3:26.en:
$$かなめ$$
「(If I shoot this man, I can go to $$宗介$$...)」

526:t_3:27.en:
$$かなめ$$
「(A hateful man... There's no reason to hesitate... If I just pull this trigger...!)」

526:t_3:30.en:
$$かなめ$$
「(This is probably my last chance to see $$宗介$$... I know that... I know, but...)」

526:t_3:31.en:
$$かなめ$$
「(I don't have the resolve to take a human life)」

526:t_3:32.en:
$$かなめ$$
「(How frustrating... He must have seen right through my heart, and still he does this...)」

526:t_3:36.en:
$$レナード$$
「He fights to see you, and doesn't even hesitate to kill.」

526:t_3:37.en:
$$レナード$$
「Yet you can't even shoot one pretentious jerk like me.」

526:t_3:38.en:
$$レナード$$
「In the end, that's all your resolve amounts to.」

526:t_3:40.en:
$$かなめ$$
「(That's not true. I want to see him right now... I want to leap into $$宗介$$'s arms right now...)」

526:t_3:41.en:
$$レナード$$
「The bet is over. Now, hand over that gun.」

526:t_3:42.en:
$$かなめ$$
「(If I escape from here, this time I truly won't be able to see him again...)」

526:t_3:46.en:
$$かなめ$$
「(I can't bear never seeing him again... Help me... $$宗介$$...!)」

526:t_3:50.en:
$$かなめ$$
「(I shot him... I broke the rules...)」

526:t_3:51.en:
$$かなめ$$
「(No... I never meant to shoot! It was an accident in the struggle...!)」

526:t_3:54.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I... I didn't mean to shoot...」

526:t_3:55.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「...He's still breathing. Take him in at once and treat him.」

526:t_3:58.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「You come too. This place is...」
